items.title: Ethereum L2 Starknet Jumps 20% After Saying It Wants to Become an L1
items.body: Starknet is "actively considering" becoming its own blockchain, a move it says would make it the first fully quantum-resistant network by 2027.

items.title: Ledger investigates potential wallet tampering after reports of $86 million in crypto stolen
items.body: The hardware wallet maker said it is investigating devices sold by a Southeast Asian reseller as social posts swirl about crypto assets drained from Bitcoin, Ethereum and Tron addresses.

items.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush
items.body: About $356 million in ETH positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more than bitcoin despite ether’s market value being less than a fifth as large.

items.title: Ethereum Test Network Raises Block Limit to Over 3x Its Current Capacity
items.body: Ethereum's Sepolia test network activated Glamsterdam on October 6 with a block gas limit near 200 million, over three times mainnet's 60 million.

items.title: Will AI Break Crypto Encryption? Ethereum’s Vitalik Buterin Weighs In on 'Bunker Mode' Shift
items.body: Ethereum co-founder Vitalik Buterin thinks the crypto industry needs to make sure encryption is both quantum and AI-resistant.

items.title: Morning Minute: AI Could Break Crypto Encryption Before Quantum, Says Ethereum Researcher
items.body: Justin Drake is calling for crypto holders to start calmly planning for “Bunker Mode." But reactions so far haven’t been too calm.
